newsitem.title: USA: AT&T responds to NYNEX criticism.
newsitem.headline: AT&T responds to NYNEX criticism.

text.p: AT&T Corp on Friday responded to criticism by NYNEX Corp that it could not reach agreement on a local network interconnection deal with the long distance company.

"We are very disappointed with NYNEX for the lack of sincere support to act in good faith to close this agreement," said David Jefferson, AT&T vice president for local services for the north east region.
NYNEX complained to the New York Public Service Commission to seek its help in reaching agreement.
Regional Bells have to open up their local calling networks to competition before they will be allowed to offer long distance calling within those regions, under the terms of the 1996 Telecom Act.
